bootstrap.auto-fail-sins-evaluator:
- Floating-point money math anywhere in application code — money is integer cents, always
- SQL issued outside the core data-access layer (`src/core`) — UI components never run queries
- GnuCash file access bypassing the `gnucash-data-model` skill's guardrails: reads without a
  read-only connection; writes without lock/version/backup discipline; touching `slots` or
  `versions`
- Tests that touch the user's real book, real GnuCash file, or real xlsx — fixtures and temp
  directories only
- An importer that silently drops input cells instead of parsing them or surfacing them as
  unparsed
- Tests that assert nothing or mock the unit under test; live external-service/network calls
  from tests
- Real bill data (actual payees, account last-4s) committed to the repo — placeholders only
bootstrap.auto-fail-sins-qa:
- Money rendered with floating-point artifacts (e.g. `$0.30000000000000004`) or wrong cents
- Import reports success while input cells were silently dropped (absent from both parsed
  data and the unparsed-review surface)
- Any write to a real GnuCash book without backup/lock/version discipline
- Browser console errors on the affected views
- Success reported without the database state actually changing
- Raw stack traces shown in the UI; secrets or real bill data in any output or screenshot
bootstrap.auto-fail-triggers: Float money math, SQL outside src/core, GnuCash guardrail bypass, tests touching real user files, importers silently dropping cells, assertion-free tests, real bill data committed

bootstrap.mock-boundary: Mock at the Tauri boundary (`@tauri-apps/api` `invoke` and plugin modules) and at the core `db.ts` adapter seam — use `better-sqlite3` temp databases for real SQL behavior rather than mocking queries; Rust tests use temp directories. Fixtures live under `tests/fixtures/`. Never touch the user's real book, real GnuCash file, or real xlsx — fixtures and temp directories only.
bootstrap.models-map-caveats:
- **Claude Code env overrides**: `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` and
  `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` override frontmatter; org `availableModels` allowlists can
  cause pins to be ignored.
- **Claude Code is single-provider**: it runs Anthropic models only, so fix-cycle 2
  rotation and the rung-5 arbiter are same-family (reduced diversity / independence).
- **Claude Code aliases resolve per provider**: an alias such as `opus` maps to a
  different model on Bedrock, Google Cloud, or Foundry than on the Anthropic API.
  Pins verified on Claude Code 2.1.325.
- **Claude Code usage-credit aliases**: headless loop runs must never resolve to
  `best`/`fable` (they bill usage credits without asking); the loop chain is
  `sonnet,haiku` only.
bootstrap.models-map-effort: Reasoning-effort pins: evaluators (`evaluator`, `qa-evaluator`) `high`, `diagnostician` `xhigh`, `implementer`/`test-writer`/`evidence-collector` `medium`, `terminal` `low` — Claude Code `effort:` frontmatter. Never quote the YAML `model:` value — a quoted or unresolvable value silently falls back to the parent model.

bootstrap.qa-surfaces-keep:
### Desktop UI (Tauri) — the only user-facing surface
- Screenshots (captured via the Vite dev URL per the `tauri-qa-testing` skill) show the
  affected views rendering correctly.
- Browser console is free of errors; dev-server output free of unhandled errors.
- Money amounts render as exact cents — never floating-point artifacts, never wrong
  rounding.
- Import flows surface every unparsed cell in the review UI; no input silently dropped.
- Reported effects are verified directly in the SQLite app database (integer-cent
  values, expected rows present).
- GnuCash operations show the guardrails held: backups exist for writes; reads never
  mutate the book.

tokens.STACK_SUMMARY: fin-app is a local-first, cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) desktop personal-finance app: a **Tauri 2.x** shell, a **React + TypeScript** UI (Vite, npm), a platform-agnostic **TypeScript core** data-access layer (`src/core`) over **SQLite** (app-owned `rusqlite` backend in `src-tauri/src/db.rs`, migrations in `src-tauri/migrations`, one file = one book), and **Rust commands** for xlsx parsing (`calamine`), reports, backups, and GnuCash sqlite3 file access. It replaces the monthly bill-pay xlsx workflow and integrates with GnuCash (read / QIF export / guarded write).
